passage:
A young man played guitar outside the subway station every Friday evening. Many people walked past quickly. Some dropped coins into his case.
One evening, a string broke during a song. He stopped and looked embarrassed.
An old man from the crowd stepped forward and offered a spare string from his bag. He said he used to play guitar too.
While the young man fixed the guitar, the old man told a short story about his band many years ago. People stayed to listen.
When the music started again, the crowd was larger than before.
The broken string interrupted the song, but it also created a moment that music alone might not have made.
